us.label: US News
us.subtitle: Top domestic stories from the last 1–2 days

articles.title: Senate passes bipartisan energy permitting bill
bullets: The Senate approved legislation Thursday to speed energy infrastructure reviews.
The bill targets power plants, transmission lines, pipelines and mines.
Supporters say it would address rising electricity demand and costs.

articles.title: Congress faces shutdown risk amid Iran-war funding dispute
bullets: Lawmakers warned funding talks could fail before a pre-Christmas deadline.
Trump is seeking $350 billion in new Pentagon spending.
Democrats are preparing to take control of Congress in January.

articles.title: Justice Department seeks dismissal of Alaska Senate race challenge
bullets: The DOJ moved to dismiss a lawsuit challenging Alaska’s Senate race.
The filing comes after Mary Peltola’s Senate victory was called.
The case remains part of post-election legal fallout.

articles.title: Trump administration replaces top cybersecurity official
bullets: The administration named a new top cybersecurity official.
The move follows recent widespread technology disruptions.
The role oversees federal cybersecurity coordination and response.

articles.title: House Democrat demands preservation of official app messages
bullets: A senior House Democrat sought preservation of agency communications.
The request covers messages created on nongovernment apps.
The effort signals expected oversight fights in the next Congress.

articles.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold high-profile summit in Shenzhen
bullets: The three leaders met during China’s APEC-hosted diplomacy week.
Xi described the talks as positive and fruitful.
The summit highlighted China’s central role in global diplomacy.

articles.title: Kyiv allies push back after Trump-Putin Ukraine diplomacy
bullets: European allies reacted warily to U.S.-Russia security discussions.
Jared Kushner said Russia was comfortable with NATO-like assurances.
Ukraine’s partners continued pressing for Kyiv’s role in any deal.

articles.title: Rights groups seek sanctions after World Court Rohingya ruling
bullets: The ICJ found Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya Muslims.
Rights groups urged arms embargoes and economic sanctions.
China and Russia could block Security Council enforcement steps.

articles.title: COP31 talks in Turkey near close with fossil-fuel dispute unresolved
bullets: Negotiators remained divided over fossil-fuel language.
Experts warned emissions cuts are needed to avoid worse warming.
The next climate summit is scheduled for Addis Ababa in 2027.

articles.title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles and drones
bullets: Saudi Arabia reported intercepting additional Houthi attacks from Yemen.
The incident underscored continuing regional security volatility.
The attacks came amid broader Middle East tensions.

articles.title: India and Japan deepen defense cooperation in Tokyo talks
bullets: India and Japan agreed to expand military and defense-industry cooperation.
Japanese troops may train at Indian live-fire ranges.
Ministers framed the partnership as an Indo-Pacific stabilizer.

articles.title: Parliamentary panel briefed on India-Europe relations
bullets: Commerce and External Affairs officials briefed a parliamentary committee.
The briefing covered opportunities and challenges in India-Europe ties.
Shashi Tharoor said the panel would submit a report soon.

articles.title: Nepal prime minister Balen Shah to visit India
bullets: Nepal’s prime minister is scheduled to visit India on November 22–23.
The trip is his first official India visit as prime minister.
Bilateral ties and regional issues are expected on the agenda.

articles.title: Rahul Gandhi says talks with Pakistan impossible amid killings
bullets: Rahul Gandhi criticized engagement with Pakistan during continuing violence.
His remarks were reported in Indian political coverage Friday.
The comments came amid renewed debate over cross-border policy.
articles.source: The Hindu via World in Summary

articles.title: Modi urges industry to put ‘India First’ in investment plans
bullets: Prime Minister Modi addressed long-term industrial investment decisions.
He urged businesses to prioritize India over the next 20 years.
The remarks were carried in public broadcaster coverage.

articles.title: Anthropic falls back after historic IPO pop
bullets: Anthropic opened sharply above its IPO price Thursday.
Shares later retreated, trading near $88 premarket Friday.
The debut did not stop broader AI-stock selling.

articles.title: Nasdaq drops 2.3% as AI selloff deepens
bullets: The Nasdaq fell 550.69 points Thursday.
AI-linked stocks led another broad market decline.
The S&P 500 and Dow also finished lower.

articles.title: Nvidia volatility persists after earnings beat and leadership turmoil
bullets: Nvidia reported revenue of $115.8 billion for fiscal Q3.
Adjusted earnings beat Wall Street expectations.
Leadership concerns continued to pressure sentiment toward the stock.

articles.title: Intuit, Ross Stores and Keysight draw premarket attention
bullets: Investors watched post-earnings moves in Intuit, Ross and Keysight.
Keysight beat fourth-quarter earnings and revenue estimates.
Futures pointed lower before Friday’s open.

articles.title: Chinese tech stocks hit by new U.S. AI-chip curbs
bullets: U.S. restrictions pressured Chinese technology shares this week.
Measures target access to advanced AI chips and cloud compute.
Investors weighed China’s push for chip self-sufficiency.

articles.title: Banks earn major fees from Anthropic IPO
bullets: Anthropic’s offering became a major payday for Wall Street banks.
The stock opened at $111.50 after an $83 offering price.
Shares closed Thursday at $97.17.

articles.title: Citigroup misstated European trading-unit risk assets
bullets: Citigroup incorrectly recorded certain European trading-unit trades.
The error understated risk-weighted assets by about $35 billion.
The issue was reported by Reuters.

articles.title: Drugmakers say AI is speeding early-stage development
bullets: Pharmaceutical executives said AI shortened early molecule-development timelines.
Some companies reported cuts of up to half in early work.
The gains affect preclinical drug discovery workflows.

articles.title: Alphabet raises C$6 billion in Canadian bond sale
bullets: Alphabet raised C$6 billion through a four-tranche offering.
The pricing terms were filed with the SEC.
The deal adds to large tech-sector debt issuance.

articles.title: Britain and EU set to ease food trade and youth mobility
bullets: The U.K. and EU prepared a post-Brexit reset package.
The deal would ease food trade and youth mobility.
A summit Friday was expected to address longer-term ties.

articles.title: U.S. chip curbs unsettle China’s AI sector
bullets: Washington expanded measures limiting China’s access to advanced AI chips.
Chinese firms face pressure across chips, cloud and disclosures.
The curbs accelerated debate over domestic chip self-sufficiency.

articles.title: Alibaba warns U.S. AI-chip rules may affect data-center plans
bullets: Alibaba reported strong AI cloud and compute growth.
The company warned U.S. restrictions could affect overseas expansion.
Other Chinese tech firms are reassessing AI infrastructure plans.

articles.title: Tech outages blamed on rushed fixes, not coordinated cyberattack
bullets: Twenty CEO Joe Lin discussed recent outage patterns at Axios’ summit.
He said AI-discovered vulnerabilities prompted rushed organizational fixes.
Officials have not attributed the outages to a coordinated attack.

articles.title: Commerce issues advanced-computing export-control rule
bullets: The Commerce Department published new advanced-computing controls.
The rule targets foreign access to U.S.-origin compute capabilities.
Data centers and chip exporters face added due-diligence requirements.

articles.title: Apple hiring points to new agentic AI assistant effort
bullets: A Bloomberg-spotted job listing described an agentic assistant role.
The assistant would browse the web and work across apps.
The role suggests Apple is expanding hands-on AI agent development.
articles.source: The Verge via The day’s tech, sifted
